MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

The activation occurs on repeated instances of a token in information or confirmation contexts, often related to quantity changes or simple arithmetic. The neuron responds strongly to elements focused on a particular number or quantity, typically highlighted for emphasis.

L22·N11069unmasked layer
Fires on the token immediately preceding a numeral (usually the bare space, or a preceding "for"/"of") when the upcoming number is a quantity/count/statistic (points scored, stitch count, receptions/yards, class year); it is strongly *suppressed* in the same position when the upcoming number is a calendar date ("on Jan. 20", "on 9th March").
